title: Residential schools in Alberta
description: Explore the various residential schools in Alberta and their histories.
overviewDescription: The map marks St. Mary's on the Blood (Kainai Nation) reserve, St. Albert (Youville), and Lesser Slave Lake (St. Peter's). Select a point to learn about its location, operating years, and archival record.

schools.name: St. Mary's Residential School (Blood)

schools.name: St. Albert Residential School (Youville)
schools.description: The school was in St. Albert, northwest of Edmonton, within Treaty 6 territory.

schools.name: Lesser Slave Lake Residential School (St. Peter's)
